topNavRemoval.strategy: route composition without Tablet shell wrapper plus runtime DOM removal guard for shell-injected upper nav only inside /tablet-lab

layoutMinimalism.rule: fewest containers possible; no panel-inside-panel nesting unless it creates intentional optical glass/refraction/specular effect
layoutMinimalism.controls: control dropdowns and knobs live outside atmospheric canvas in a single left column
layoutMinimalism.transparentZero: glass controls can reach zero so preview panels become actually transparent when optical knobs are zero
